narrative: 钠灯变成了一团光球。站台在虚无中戛然而止。
一件大衣姗姗来迟地出现，仿佛世界只有手电筒照亮的那么大。隐藏地理空间。
延迟揭示。用在恐怖片、码头、伦敦街道，或任何需要隐瞒下一个景深层次的段落中。
如果你仍需要几公里范围内可辨识的风景，这不是合适的手法——那该用空气感薄雾（Atmospheric Haze）。如果那层薄纱应该轻薄而抒情，也不该用它——那该用薄雾（Mist）。
有燃烧来源的是烟（Smoke）。如果三米外的脸依然清晰，只是调色偏灰，那你拥有的不是雾。
how: 用浓密的水珠（雾机或天气）填满一个空间，让对比度在很短的距离内迅速下降。用逆光或侧光照亮雾气，让实景光源周围形成光晕球；正面光会把它拍成一片死白的牛奶色。
让实景光源本身也处在这团"浓汤"之中，而不只是给镜头加一层滤镜。提示词：dense fog around [Subject], depth collapsing, lamps becoming globes, figures appearing late, horror or London grammar.
when: 当人物该姗姗来迟地出现、道路该消失在白色之中、房子该没有院子时使用。不要用在你仍需要看清的远景上。
如果远处的山脊必须保持可辨识，就用空气感薄雾或薄雾。
vs: 薄雾（Mist）更稀薄：层次分明、可以透视、富有抒情感。空气感薄雾（Atmospheric Haze）是在几公里范围内层层叠加变淡的景深平面，而不是十米外的一堵墙。
烟（Smoke）有来源和方向，不是天气现象。蒸汽（Steam）由热量产生，随冷却而变稀薄。
雾是局部的、浓密的水汽帷幕。
examples_film: 《驱魔人》（The Exorcist）和《小岛惊魂》（The Others）用雾来隐藏房屋、灯光和人体。《边境杀手》（Sicario）则让沙尘和类似雾气的帷幕抹去沙漠的边缘（在不透明度上是近亲）。
要用延迟揭示和灯光周围的光晕球，而不是照搬一个"墓地"场景。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是空气感薄雾（Atmospheric Haze，用于表现距离）或一层去饱和调色。破绽在于：一个街区外的建筑依然清晰、灯光周围没有光晕球、三十米外的脸依然被照得清清楚楚。
修正方法：缩短能见度，让灯光逆光形成光晕，让人物姗姗来迟地出现。

faq.a: 雾是一团浓密的局部水珠云，能隐藏景深。灯光会晕染成光球，人物只有走进近景地面才会显现出来。
雾的不透明度足以在很短的距离内让空间坍缩。薄雾更稀薄、有层次，仍能让你看清下一个景深层次。雾是隐藏，薄雾是轻纱。
用它来隐藏地理空间、延迟揭示。当你需要一段可辨识的远景时不要用它，也不要用一层灰色LUT来伪造它。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写雾的提示词？
faq.a: 点明"浓汤感"和光晕。示例：dense fog around [Subject], lamps becoming globes, figures appearing late. 设定一个较短的能见度距离，并禁止远处细节保持清晰。

narrative: A sodium lamp becomes a ball. A platform ends in nothing.
A coat arrives late, as if the world were only as large as a flashlight. Hide geography.
Delay the reveal. Use it for horror, docks, London streets, any beat that should withhold the next plane.
It is the wrong tool when you still want kilometers of readable landscape: that is Atmospheric Haze. It is the wrong tool when the veil is thin and lyrical: that is Mist.
Combustion with a source is Smoke. If faces at three meters are crisp and only the grade is grey, you do not have fog.
how: Fill a volume with dense droplets (machines or weather) so contrast falls with distance on a short scale. Backlight or sidelight the fog to make globes around practicals; front light flattens it to milk.
Keep practicals inside the soup, not only a filter on the lens. Prompt: dense fog around [Subject], depth collapsing, lamps becoming globes, figures appearing late, horror or London grammar.
when: Use it when a figure should appear late, a road should end in white, a house should have no yard. Do not use it on a vista you still need to read.
If the far ridge must stay a ridge, use haze or mist.
vs: Mist is thinner: layered, see-through, lyric. Atmospheric Haze stacks paler planes over kilometers, not a wall at ten meters.
Smoke has a source and a direction and is not weather. Steam rises from heat and thins as it cools.
Fog is a local, dense water veil.
examples_film: The Exorcist and The Others use fog to withhold houses, lamps, and bodies. Sicario lets dust and fog-like veils erase desert edges (a cousin in opacity).
Use delayed reveal and globes around lamps, not a copied graveyard.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is Atmospheric Haze (distance) or a desaturated grade. The tell: sharp buildings a block away, lamps with no globes, faces fully lit at thirty meters.
The fix: short visibility, backlit bloom on lights, late arrivals.

faq.a: Fog is a dense local cloud of water droplets that hides depth. Lamps bloom into globes and figures appear only when they enter the near ground.
Fog is opaque enough to collapse geography at short range. Mist is thinner, layered, and still lets you read the next plane. Fog withholds; mist veils.
Use it to hide geography and delay a reveal. Do not use it when you need a long, readable landscape, and do not fake it with a grey LUT.

faq.q: How do I prompt Fog for AI image or video?
faq.a: Name the soup and the bloom. Example: dense fog around [Subject], lamps becoming globes, figures appearing late. Give a short visibility distance and forbid crisp far detail.
